seal.statement: A push is proved against exactly the bytes being pushed and against everything a test observes: the pre-push gate materialises the pushed SHA once and runs every stage (unused-files, eslint, cycles, unused-exports, the corpus ratchets and the test stage) in that immutable checkout, naming the pushed ref, the pushed SHA and the remote base in a declared stage manifest the gate consumes; the selection's authorities include non-import observation dependencies (files read through fs, globbed directories, spawned scripts, environment variables) declared per test and censused from the test sources, so a change to an observed surface selects its observers and an undeclared surface escalates; the observation-surface census prints the number of tests with a detected-but-undeclared surface; and adversarial falsifiers plant a defect in an observed non-import surface and in behavioural source and prove end to end that the gate selects a test that goes red; the budget rows gate_stages_off_pushed_sha, undeclared_observation_surfaces and falsifier_classes_unproven read zero, and until they do no further narrowing or caching enters the gate.

text: Three pillars. (1) Exact identity: .githooks/pre-push declares its stages by id in test/manifests/pre-push-stages.json (every content-reading stage: tree pushed-sha); outside an exact checkout it saves the pushed ref lines, materialises the first pushed local sha once through scripts/checks/push-gate-corpus-worktree.js --gate (snapshot worktree under test-output/push-gate-worktrees, reset --hard + clean, node_modules and data linked by the publisher's linking owner, LAGRANGE_WORKSPACE_INJECTIONS/LAGRANGE_GATE_PUSHED_SHA/LAGRANGE_GATE_RED_MAIN_CHECKED exported, ref lines forwarded on stdin) and re-runs itself there; the inner run prints the identity line (checkout HEAD, pushed ref, main base) and refuses if HEAD is not the pushed sha; a dirty checkout or a replaced injection link refuses; a manual invocation gates HEAD; a deletion-only push proves nothing; the old ratchet-only --ref materialisation is gone. (2) Observation surfaces: scripts/checks/test-subsystem-classification.js censuses every classified test's non-import surfaces from its source (quoted literals resolving to existing repository files or directories, relative or repository-rooted with a separator, joined path.join/resolve calls reconstructed, import lines skipped, process.env names) into the subsystem manifest's observations (own digest); change-selection.js admits every observer of a changed path (reason observer:<kind>:<path>, before the inert skip, so a read document selects its reader) and refuses with UNKNOWN_SCOPE when the committed census drifted from the live one (the gate then runs the whole corpus). 575 tests observe 1563 files, 106 directories (17 whole-src guards, including the gateway-registry guardrail that hid the 2026-09-13 latent red) and 32 env names. (3) Falsifiers: test/scripts/proof-authority-falsifiers.test.js builds a disposable repository and proves, green-before and red-after, that a defect in a read fixture, a listed directory, a spawned script and product source selects its observer and the runner fails, and that a working-tree-only defect is invisible to --gate while a committed one fails; scripts/quest-evidence/proof-authority-integrity.js writes the receipt. Budget rows gate_stages_off_pushed_sha, undeclared_observation_surfaces, falsifier_classes_unproven read 0/0/0; probe 0. Witnesses: test/scripts/pre-push-stage-manifest.test.js, test/scripts/observation-census.test.js; 15 existing selection suites green with three spine-only expectations re-expressed to admit observer-reason tests (a docs change now runs the documentation audits that read it; a package.json bump runs the tests that read package.json). Runbook paragraph added. No new file under scripts/ outside quest-evidence, no workflow.

r1 REJECT (category-complete). identity: (1) an ambient LAGRANGE_WORKSPACE_INJECTIONS makes the hook gate the working tree in place with the identity stage skipped (LAGRANGE_GATE_PUSHED_SHA unset) and a HEAD != pushed sha passes; (2) the stage-manifest witness is textual: three hook mutations (exit $? deleted, guard inverted, identity refusal neutered) keep it and the row green; (3) an annotated tag as first pushed ref refuses spuriously (tag object sha vs peeled HEAD) and --gate HEAD exports the literal HEAD; (4) the snapshot copies working-tree untracked files and clean -fd without -x keeps those the pushed .gitignore ignores; (5) SIGINT during the inner run strands the checkout; (6) outer trap names materialize-pushed-tree for every inner failure. census (reject ground): under-selection of real tests - bare root literal read directly (collectSourceFiles('src')), nested parens in join/resolve (path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'src')), new URL('bare/relative', import.meta.url), multi-line join/resolve calls, template literals with ${} (solve/quests/${id}); three more whole-src walkers uncensused. budget-rows: gate row counts declarations only; undeclared row measures drift against the same generator, never a surface the regex misses; falsifier receipt carries no tree binding so a stale receipt reads 0. falsifiers: all five prove detection green-before/red-after, but working-tree-not-proof proves --run, not the hook; classifyFixtureTests leaves digests stale; fixture workspaces never removed. selector: the drift refusal branch has no test. Materializer smoke, publisher path, deletion-only ordering, recursion, ref-lines cleanup, concurrency, static checks, 8 selection suites, 9 witnesses and the probe all green.

Corrective attempt after r1. identity: the in-place path now refuses when the pushed ref line's commit (peeled) is not the checkout's HEAD, so an ambient LAGRANGE_WORKSPACE_INJECTIONS can never gate a working tree; the outer branch peels an annotated tag to its commit and the materializer peels/rev-parses the requested sha before exporting it; --gate checks out the commit directly with git worktree add --detach (nothing copied from the working tree, so ignored files cannot leak), removes the checkout on SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP, and the outer failure names 'exact-checkout gate (the failed stage is named above)'. A behavioural witness test/scripts/pre-push-hook-control-flow.test.js runs the real hook with node/bash stubs for every content stage in a disposable repository and proves: exactly one materializer call with exactly the pushed commit and --ref-lines, no content stage in the working tree, status propagation, tag peeling, deletion-only exits without proof, manual gates HEAD, in-place refusal on a foreign HEAD (both the ref line and the exported sha), and the in-place stage order with the red-main guard not re-queried; it is the sixth receipt class hook-materialises-pushed-sha. census: rewritten around a balanced-parenthesis scanner over the whole source for join/resolve/new URL calls (nested calls, multi-line argument lists, URL relative to the test without ./), template literals contribute their static prefix, bare root names count only as arguments of filesystem-flavoured calls or in arrays of several roots (new Error('test') no longer observes test/), env surfaces include bracket access and destructuring; the three whole-src walkers r1 named (gateway-mutation-guardrails, membership-layer-boundary, replica-operation-membership-epoch-binding), the wasm fixture readers, the multi-line join reader, the solve/quests and src/authoring template readers and readdirSync('scripts') are now censused (597 tests observe 1590 files, 165 directories, 34 env names); each class is a case in test/scripts/observation-census.test.js, which also proves the selector's drift refusal end to end. receipts: harness-runtime records testFile and per-file content digests; the falsifier row accepts a receipt only when its digest of the witness equals the file's digest now. falsifiers: fixture manifests carry recomputed digests; workspaces are removed on exit. rows read 0/0/0, probe 0; 18 selection/hook/publisher suites, 6 census cases, 6 hook cases, 5 falsifiers green; complexity 1822/1822, unused-exports 1438/1438, fast-static, eslint, ambient-intrinsics and literals clean. Not changed: the undeclared_observation_surfaces row measures drift of the committed census from the live one; a class the census cannot see is the falsifiers' and the census witness's claim, recorded as such.

r2 REJECT on one ground, everything from r1 closed: identity witness behavioural and twelve hook mutations caught (exit dropped, guard inverted, either refusal neutered, tag peel dropped, always HEAD, --ref-lines dropped, red-main re-queried, a stage before materialising, --in-place instead of --gate, ref export dropped, status swallowed); the r1 census classes all censused and selected; drift refusal proven; receipt binding real (a one-byte witness edit or an r1-shape receipt reads 6 unproven); falsifiers 22/22 with workspaces removed; 21 suites and all static checks green; probe 0. Remaining under-selection: surfaces observed THROUGH AN IMPORTED HELPER - 82 helpers under test/ and scripts/ walk a repository directory and 51 classified tests import one without naming the directory themselves; live examples: test/scripts/check-operation-dispatch-completion-owner.test.js walks all of src/ through scripts/check-operation-dispatch-completion-owner.js (a src/rebalancer change is MISSING), the causal-graph-builder tests load topology-convergence fixtures through test/diagnostics/causal-analysis-fixtures.js, owner-interaction-model.test.js reads architecture/contracts through its harness module. Fix shape: union the surfaces of the test's helper import closure. Row framing: undeclared_observation_surfaces accepted only as census drift; the independent oracle asked for is a runtime fs/child_process trace preload or an AST walk over the test plus its helper closure.

Corrective attempt after r2 (helper-mediated observation). observationSurfacesOf now unions the surfaces of the test's relative import closure: non-test modules under test/ and scripts/ reached through relative import/export-from/import() specifiers, each scanned with the same rules anchored at its own path; src/test-helpers (the hub nearly every test imports) is not followed and *-constants.js vocabulary tables are skipped, because following them made 81 tests whole-src observers through names that are not reads. The three r2 examples are censused (the dispatch-completion checker test observes scripts, src and test; the causal-graph-builder tests observe the topology-convergence fixtures; owner-interaction-model observes architecture/contracts and the model directories); 769 tests observe 3002 files, 498 directories (57 whole-src observers: the guardrail, governance and guideline-checker suites) and 109 env names. The drift refusal now ignores tests that are themselves in the change set (a changed test is selected regardless; drift matters for the unchanged test the census would misplace), so editing a test's literals no longer refuses its own push while the committed census stays a hard requirement for every other test (audit:shards demands regeneration). Witness: a helper-closure case in test/scripts/observation-census.test.js (7 cases). 19 selection/hook/publisher/census suites, 11 falsifier and hook cases, receipt 6/6 with digests, rows 0/0/0, probe 0, complexity and unused-exports ratchets held, fast-static, eslint, ambient-intrinsics and literals clean.

r3 APPROVE (same verifier). Helper closure: every r2 example selected with observer reasons; helper-probe re-run finds no realistic under-selection (the 7 remaining helper-only observations are through the constants vocabulary table, whose one readdirSync is a comment); the two exclusions hide no reader today (src/test-helpers reads only a tmpdir state file); closure cycle-safe; drift exemption for changed tests opens no under-selection (a surface selects only its own observer, a changed helper still drifts every unchanged importer). 23 witness cases, 22 suites (185 assertions), rows 0, static clean, audit:shards current.

Declared limits and follow-ups from verification: (1) the row undeclared_observation_surfaces measures drift of the committed census from the live census; a class the regex cannot see is covered only by the census witness and the falsifiers, and the independent oracle to build later is a runtime fs/child_process trace preload over each classified test (or an AST walk over the test plus its helper closure) diffed against the manifest - a gate-work-consolidation candidate once it can be input-triggered; (2) the closure excludes src/test-helpers/ and *-constants.js by name, so a future module there that reads repository content on a test's behalf is invisible to the census; the exclusion is pinned by the census witness; (3) observationSchemaVersion stays 2 across the helper-closure change because the manifest digest and the drift check moved with it; (4) the eslint cache inside the gate checkout is cold on every direct push (about 30 s) - an efficiency item for gate-work-consolidation, as is unifying the publisher's exact-HEAD worktree with the hook's --gate materialiser (two materialisers, one linking owner today).

Witness only, after the land's corpus caught it: test/scripts/apparatus-release-consolidation-budget.test.js keeps an independent copy of the sealed budget table and measures every row against a met and an offending fixture tree; the three new rows are restated there (thresholds 0; met values 0/0/0; offending values 1/1/6) with fixture material for each: a stage manifest with a working-tree stage, an observer test whose committed census omits its file, and no falsifier receipt versus a receipt whose digest binds a witness file in the fixture. No gate, selection or census code changed since r3; the subsystem manifest was regenerated for the witness's new literals.

r4 APPROVE (same verifier): witness-only delta since r3 (the budget witness's sealed table and fixtures, plus regenerated seal and inventory); fixture values are measurements through the real row code (met 0/0/0, offending 1/1/6), 6/6 pass, eslint clean, audit:shards current, rows 0.

Altitude check after four attempts. The attempts were one build and three verifier-driven narrowings (behavioural hook witness and in-place identity refusal; five census literal classes; helper-mediated observation; a sealed-table restatement in the budget witness), not a change of approach: the three pillars - one immutable checkout per push, observation surfaces as a censused authority that only widens, falsifiers that prove detection green-before/red-after - stood in every round, and each rejection named a concrete under-selection or a proof that was textual where it had to be behavioural. The altitude is right for the sealed statement: a static census over test sources plus their helper closure is what the statement says (censused from the test sources), and the verifier's stronger oracle (a runtime fs trace) is recorded as the follow-up rather than folded in, because it is a different owner of truth (observed at run time) and belongs with the efficiency work that can make it input-triggered. Cost signal: the helper closure raised whole-src observers to 57 and whole-test observers to 60; those are the guardrail and governance suites, which is proof the change proof owed and never ran, so the widening is accepted rather than tuned away. No further narrowing or caching enters the gate from this quest; gate-work-consolidation takes the efficiency items recorded on this log. Landing proceeds.
